infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is needed to record animal encounters and survey transect tracks. Locations are generalized to 1 km before any public sharing to protect animals.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Your location is required in the background to record continuous transect routes and effort while surveying.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Your location is required in the background to record continuous transect routes.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed to capture photos of cats and dogs for individual re-identification.
